name: Beauty product hauls, unboxings and packing
what_it_is: Videos center on cosmetics and skincare products themselves: a flat-lay of Ozon cosmetics, a burgundy-vs-pink train case comparison of Allure Best of Beauty winners, a factory clip of beauty products being made, a mother-daughter unboxing of soaps, shampoo and masks, packing a skincare/makeup bag for a trip to Korea, and an Amazon holiday beauty sale flat-lay. They share a subject (beauty products) rather than one triggering moment.
